_doc: ALLOW-LIST of skips (⊘ = neither pass nor fail). Every skip the suite emits MUST appear here, or the run REDS. why=corpus-absent → the leg needs a raw recording from the gitignored uploads/ corpus, so it cannot run on a fresh clone (CI, or the worktree CLAUDE.md §👥 mandates); point DEX_UPLOADS=<path> at a real corpus to actually run it. why=known-drift → a deliberate, documented environmental skip. Adding an entry here is a DELIBERATE act that shrinks the gate — justify it in the PR. See EFFICIENCY-AUDIT-FINDINGS-2026-07-12 §G1. Each entry ALSO declares `detail`: a literal SUBSTRING of the reason the leg hands T.skip. A leg that keeps a declared name and skips for a reason the entry does not declare reds as reason-drift, and an entry with no `detail` reds as no-declared-reason — a declared NAME alone never satisfies the audit (residue 2026-11-08-the-skip-audit-matches-a-name-and-never-the-reason). The per-category tally lives in this list, so no header counter restates it.

browserLane._doc: THE BROWSER REALM'S BUDGET, enforced by tests/browser-gates.mjs (auditBrowserSkips). The `allow` list above binds the NODE lane only: `auditSkips` runs in tests/run-tests.mjs, and Dex-Test-Suite.html names this file nowhere (residue 2026-11-08-the-browser-lane-has-no-skip-budget). MEASURED 2026-11-10 in a fresh worktree of origin/main: the browser realm's headless floor emits 197 skips over 941 groups and 13973 assertions. Per-skip entries would pin 197 realm differences, and 20 of those skips hand T.skip a reason as the NAME with no detail, which no `allow` entry can ever match. So the browser realm gets three numbers instead. `budget` is a CEILING and may only shrink; it is one-sided because 15 of the 197 skips need a gitignored recording, so a checkout that HAS the corpus runs them and the count falls - the gate prints the slack and stays green. CI has no corpus, so there the ceiling sits tight. `reasonClasses` declares every reason a browser skip may carry, read as a literal substring of the detail, or of the test NAME when the detail is empty; a novel reason reds whatever the count does, which is the swap a ceiling alone cannot see. `reasonInNameOnly` pins the 20 reason-in-name skips and reds the 21st, so a new leg is pushed toward the declarable shape. Lowering any of the three is the deliberate act; raising one shrinks the gate and owes a justification in the PR.
